title: Overnight Cooked Russian Beetroot Bowl
description: A citrusy and aerated Russian dish featuring cooked beetroot, perfect for midnight cravings, cooked in ttukbaegi earthenware and served in a lacquerware bowl, sugar free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware pot in the oven at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped beetroot to the bowl and toss to coat with the lemon juice mixture.
Remove the preheated ttukbaegi pot from the oven and carefully add the beetroot mixture to the pot.
Add the water to the pot and cover with a lid.
Return the pot to the oven and cook for 6 hours or overnight.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Stir in the chopped fresh dill.
Spoon the cooked beetroot mixture into a lacquerware bowl and serve.
